stories.title: Many Iranians are heading to Turkey to escape the ongoing war's heavy toll
stories.description: Iranians visiting the city of Van, Turkey, near the Iranian border say how expensive and difficult life back home is.

stories.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
stories.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

stories.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
stories.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.

stories.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
stories.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

stories.title: Houthis reportedly kill six in first deadly attack since start of Iran war
stories.description: Iran's proxy says it hit a ship with Saudi military equipment in the Red Sea, as tensions over the US-Iran war remain high.

stories.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after two soldiers killed by explosion
stories.description: Lebanese authorities says one person was killed in the strikes, which came after the first Israeli military fatalities in Lebanon in more than a month.

stories.title: Iranian footballers who defied Tehran become Australian citizens
stories.description: There were among seven to be granted humanitarian visas while playing in Australia - but the other five changed their minds and returned to Iran.

stories.title: Houthi attacks reportedly kill at least 30 Yemeni government forces
stories.description: The Houthis say they launched missiles and drones at "Saudi military build-ups" in the central provinces of Marib and Hadramawt.

stories.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon again as families flee north
stories.description: Israeli airstrikes hit the Nabatieh district of southern Lebanon just hours after the deadliest day of Israeli raids.

stories.title: Yemeni government forces hit back after new Houthi offensive
stories.description: Yemeni government forces, backed by Saudi Arabia, have struck back after a new Houthi offensive in areas it controls.

stories.title: Iran war live: Talks on Hormuz Strait continue; Israel kills 11 in Lebanon
stories.description: Israel kills 11 in deadliest attacks on Lebanon since June truce as Iran and Oman continue talks on Hormuz.

stories.title: Yemen’s government says Houthi strikes hit residential areas in Marib
stories.description: Yemen's Ministry of Information denounces attacks on Marib as 'escalation' that threatens lives and increases suffering.

stories.title: Qatar denies Tehran’s claim it is detaining Iranian bomber pilots
stories.description: Iran claims Qatar is holding three pilots who were shot down in March. Doha decries 'misleading statements'.

stories.title: US aircraft carrier expected to relieve USS Lincoln in Middle East
stories.description: The USS Washington's movement comes amid reports of dire conditions on the USS Lincoln amid the ongoing Iran war.

stories.title: Iran fires back at Trump's threat to declare Hormuz a U.S. territory
stories.description: Mr. Trump has repeatedly said the strait, which Tehran effectively closed at the start of the West Asia war in late February, is under U.S. control an assertion the Islamic Republic denies

stories.description: The armed forces aligned with the Yemeni government said the attack ‌targeted civilian infrastructure and national assets at the port. Initial ‌reports ⁠said four civilians were killed and several fishing boats ⁠were set on fire

stories.description: "Three Iranian pilots were captured alive by Qatari forces after their Su-24 fighter jets crashed during the war," said General Mohammad Bagherzadeh of the Iranian armed forces, Fars news agency reported
